title: Browser Workspace
downloadBlocked: Download blocked until you explicitly approve it

artifactAttached: Browser context attached to the chat input
noSelectedText: Select text on the page first
empty: Open a page to start browsing with the Agent.
cleanupPending: 工作階段清理尚未完成，請重試以移除暫存瀏覽資料。
cleanupCompleted: 瀏覽器工作階段已清理
pickElementHint: Move over the page and click the element you want to point out. Escape cancels.
pickRegionHint: 拖曳以附加頁面座標（目前不擷取像素），按 Escape 取消。
dialogDismissed: 已取消意外的網頁提示，請檢查頁面後再決定是否重試
dialogPaused: 網頁連續彈出提示，已暫停該頁面。可關閉或重新載入此分頁。
